entities.name: José Baptista Pinheiro de Azevedo
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Baptista Pinheiro de Azevedo was a Portuguese political figure, reformer and revolutionary. He helped overthrow Marcelo Caetano in 1974. He served as the 104th prime minister of Portugal between 19 September 1975 and 23 June 1976. He ran for president in 1976, and lost.
